title: Surface charge dictates the mechanism of cellular uptake of fluorescent amine passivated carbon dots
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28770-28782
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03738G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Adryanne Clermont-Paquette, Gianluca Fuoco, Cécilia R. Brancheriau, Alisa Piekny, Rafik Naccache
Carbon dots with increased amine content exhibit higher surface charge, enhancing cellular uptake. Amphiphilic DT3-CDs(+) localize in the cytosol, while hydrophilic DT3-CDs(–), PH6-CDs(±) remain in vesicles near the endomembrane system.
